summary: The ipn URI scheme names endpoints in the interplanetary Bundle Protocol, used for delay-tolerant networking. This RFC updates its specification from RFC 6260 and the registries from RFC 7116. It also updates how the URIs are encoded and decoded when used as endpoint identifiers in Bundle Protocol version 7 (RFC 9171).

eli5.summary: Mail sent across space needs addresses. This updates the address format used to name places that data can be delivered in a network built for very long delays.
